_readme: Copy next to the board file and name it <board name>.hz_layout.json; content copied from the design document. power_rules.py computes the minimum track width from power per IPC-2221 (10 C temperature rise) and generates DRC rules; prod_gate.py runs checks before export. Keys starting with _ are comments only.
_power_notes: current_a is the current the net's traces actually carry: if the trunk is a pour and traces are only branches, use the branch current; layer is the layer the traces are on, outer/inner; optional copper_oz (default 1 outer, 0.5 inner) and width_mm (margin, may only be wider than the computed value)

power.basis: [EXAMPLE VALUE - REPLACE] design document section 4, current limit 2 A
[EXAMPLE VALUE - REPLACE] design document section x

checks._hs_review_gbps_notes: For MIPI/HDMI also add --stub prefix=15 (via stub in mil, SPEC-005 2.8) and --pair-skew prefix=30 (pair-to-pair length difference in mil, appendix C; MIPI uses the stricter 30)
checks._multi_set_notes: When the same check must run once per parameter set (several impedance widths, several plane layers), write the value as a list of parameter lists, e.g. "plane_check": [["--layer", "In1.Cu"], ["--layer", "In4.Cu"]]
checks._impedance_check_notes: Example: JLCPCB 3313 stackup, 90 ohm differential, 6.6/12.58 mil
checks._fence_check_notes: Guard-ground vias (SPEC-005 2.9): spacing MIPI 3, HDMI 4, USB 2.0 6 mm; --exempt uses the same exempt boxes as hs_review (chip fan-out, connector and ESD pad areas), relative to the drill origin
